bookInfo.name: Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance
bookInfo.author: Sima Guang

sentences.zh: 起閼逢攝提格，盡昭陽大淵獻，凡十年。

translations.literal: From Quefeng Shotige through Zhaoyang Dayuanxian; ten years in all.
translations.idiomatic: From Quefeng Shotige through Zhaoyang Dayuanxian—ten years in all.

sentences.zh: 1冬，太后議欲立諸呂為王，問右丞相陵。

translations.literal: 1. In winter the Empress Dowager deliberated on enfeoffing the various Lü as kings and questioned the right chancellor, Ling.
translations.idiomatic: 1. In winter the Empress Dowager resolved to enfeoff the Lü clan as kings and asked the right chancellor, Wang Ling.

sentences.zh: 陵曰：「高帝刑白馬盟曰：『非劉氏而王，天下共擊之。

translations.literal: Ling said: "When the High Emperor slew the white horse for the oath he declared: 'Whoever is made king though not of the Liu clan—all under Heaven shall strike him together.
translations.idiomatic: Ling said, "When the High Emperor slew the white horse for the oath, he declared: 'Whoever is made king though not of the Liu clan—all under Heaven shall strike him down together.

sentences.zh: 』今王呂氏，非約也。

translations.literal: ' Now to make the Lü clan kings is against the covenant."
translations.idiomatic: ' To make the Lü clan kings now is to break that covenant."

sentences.zh: 」太后不說，問左丞相平、太尉勃，對曰：「高帝定天下，王子弟；

translations.literal: " The Empress Dowager was displeased and questioned the left chancellor Ping and the Grand Commandant Bo; they answered: "The High Emperor settled all under Heaven and made his sons and younger brothers kings;
translations.idiomatic: " The Empress Dowager was displeased and turned to the left chancellor Chen Ping and the Grand Commandant Zhou Bo. They answered, "The High Emperor settled the realm and made his sons and brothers kings;

sentences.zh: 今太后稱制，王諸呂，無所不可。

translations.literal: now the Empress Dowager holds the regency—making the various Lü kings, nothing is impossible."
translations.idiomatic: now Your Majesty holds the regency—if you wish to make the Lü kings, what cannot be done?"

sentences.zh: 」太后喜，罷朝。

translations.literal: " The Empress Dowager was pleased and dismissed court.
translations.idiomatic: " The Empress Dowager was pleased and dismissed court.

sentences.zh: 王陵讓陳平、絳侯曰：「始與高帝啑血盟，諸君不在邪？

translations.literal: Wang Ling reproached Chen Ping and the Marquis of Jiang, saying: "At the outset we joined the High Emperor in the blood oath—were you gentlemen not there?
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ling reproached Chen Ping and the Marquis of Jiang: "At the outset we joined the High Emperor in the blood oath—were you not there?

sentences.zh: 今高帝崩，太后女主，欲王呂氏；

translations.literal: Now the High Emperor is dead, the Empress Dowager is mistress of the realm, and wishes to make the Lü kings;
translations.idiomatic: Now the High Emperor is dead, the Empress Dowager rules as sovereign, and wishes to make the Lü kings;

sentences.zh: 諸君縱欲阿意背約，何面目見高帝於地下乎？

translations.literal: if you gentlemen would only fawn and turn your backs on the covenant, with what face can you meet the High Emperor beneath the earth?"
translations.idiomatic: if you would only fawn and betray the covenant, with what face will you meet the High Emperor beneath the earth?"

sentences.zh: 」陳平、降侯曰：「於今，面折廷爭，臣不如君；

translations.literal: " Chen Ping and the Marquis of Jiang said: "For today, to refute to the face and contend in court, your servant is not your equal;
translations.idiomatic: " Chen Ping and the Marquis of Jiang said, "As for refuting to the face and contending in open court, I am not your equal;

sentences.zh: 全社稷，定劉氏之後，君亦不如臣。

translations.literal: to preserve the altars of state and secure the succession of the Liu clan, you are also not your servant's equal."
translations.idiomatic: but to preserve the altars of state and secure the house of Liu, you are not my equal."

sentences.zh: 」陵無以應之。

translations.literal: " Ling had nothing with which to reply.
translations.idiomatic: " Ling had nothing to say in reply.

sentences.zh: 十一月，甲子，太后以王陵為帝太傅，實奪之相權。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiazi, the Empress Dowager made Wang Ling Grand Tutor to the Emperor, in truth stripping him of the chancellor's power.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiazi, the Empress Dowager made Wang Ling Grand Tutor to the Emperor—in truth stripping him of the chancellor's authority.

sentences.zh: 陵遂病免歸。

translations.literal: Ling then pleaded illness, resigned, and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: Ling then pleaded illness, resigned, and went home.

sentences.zh: 乃以左丞相平為右丞相，以辟陽侯審食其為左丞相，不治事，令監宮中，如郎中令。

translations.literal: Thereupon the left chancellor Ping was made right chancellor, and the Marquis of Piyang Shen Yishi was made left chancellor; he did not govern affairs but was ordered to oversee the inner palace, like the superintendent of the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Chen Ping was moved from left to right chancellor, and the Marquis of Piyang Shen Yishi was made left chancellor; he did not govern affairs but was ordered to oversee the inner palace, like the superintendent of the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 食其故得幸於太后，公卿皆因而決事。

translations.literal: Yishi had long enjoyed favor with the Empress Dowager, and the highest ministers all relied on him to decide affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yishi had long enjoyed the Empress Dowager's favor, and the highest ministers all decided affairs through him.

sentences.zh: 太后怨趙堯為趙隱王謀，乃抵堯罪。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager resented Zhao Yao for plotting on behalf of the Hidden King of Zhao and therefore charged Yao with a crime.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager resented Zhao Yao for plotting on behalf of the Hidden King of Zhao and therefore charged him with a crime.

sentences.zh: 上黨守任敖嘗為沛獄吏，有德於太后，乃以為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Ren Ao, governor of Shangdang, had once been a jail clerk in Pei and had shown kindness to the Empress Dowager; he was therefore made grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Ao, governor of Shangdang, had once been a jail clerk in Pei and had done the Empress Dowager a kindness; he was therefore made grand secretary.

sentences.zh: 太后又追尊其父臨泗侯呂公為宣王，兄周呂令武侯澤為悼武王，欲以王諸呂為漸。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager further posthumously honored her father, Marquis of Linsi Duke Lü, as King Xuan, and her elder brother Marquis Wu of Zhoulü Lingwu Ze as King Dao, intending to make kings of the various Lü by degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager further posthumously honored her father, Marquis of Linsi Duke Lü, as King Xuan, and her elder brother Marquis Wu of Zhoulü Lingwu Ze as King Dao—laying the groundwork to make the Lü kings by degrees.

sentences.zh: ----2春，正月，除三族罪、妖言令。

translations.literal: ----2 In spring, the first month, the crime of exterminating three clans and the ban on perverse speech were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: ----2 In spring, the first month, the crime of exterminating three clans and the ban on perverse speech were abolished.

sentences.zh: ----3夏，四月，魯元公主薨。

translations.literal: ----3 In summer, the fourth month, Princess Yuan of Lu died.
translations.idiomatic: ----3 In summer, the fourth month, Princess Yuan of Lu died.

sentences.zh: 封公主子張偃為魯王，謚公主曰魯元太后。

translations.literal: Her son Zhang Yan was enfeoffed as king of Lu, and the princess was given the posthumous title Empress Dowager Yuan of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: Her son Zhang Yan was enfeoffed as king of Lu, and the princess was given the posthumous title Empress Dowager Yuan of Lu.

sentences.zh: ----4辛卯，封所名孝惠子山為襄城侯，朝為軹侯，武為壺關侯。

translations.literal: ----4 On xinmao, the sons named as sons of Emperor Hui—Shan was enfeoffed as Marquis of Xiangcheng, Chao as Marquis of Zhi, Wu as Marquis of Huguan.
translations.idiomatic: ----4 On xinmao, those styled as sons of Emperor Hui—Shan as Marquis of Xiangcheng, Chao as Marquis of Zhi, Wu as Marquis of Huguan—were enfeoffed.

sentences.zh: 太后欲王呂氏，乃先立所名孝惠子強為淮陽王，不疑為恆山王；

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager wished to make the Lü kings; she therefore first installed those named as sons of Emperor Hui—Qiang as king of Huaiyang, Buyi as king of Hengshan;
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager wished to make the Lü kings; she therefore first installed those styled as sons of Emperor Hui—Qiang as king of Huaiyang, Buyi as king of Hengshan;

sentences.zh: 使大謁者張釋風大臣。

translations.literal: she had the grand usher Zhang Shi stir up the great ministers.
translations.idiomatic: she had the grand usher Zhang Shi stir the great ministers.

sentences.zh: 大臣乃請立悼武王長子酈侯台為呂王，割齊之濟南郡為呂國。

translations.literal: The great ministers then requested that the eldest son of King Dao, Marquis Li Tai, be installed as king of Lü, and the prefecture of Jinan in Qi was cut off to form the state of Lü.
translations.idiomatic: The great ministers then requested that the eldest son of King Dao, Marquis Li Tai, be installed as king of Lü, and Jinan prefecture in Qi was carved off to form the state of Lü.

sentences.zh: ----5五月，丙申，趙王宮叢台災。

translations.literal: ----5 In the fifth month, on bingshen, the Cluster Terrace of the Zhao king's palace caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: ----5 In the fifth month, on bingshen, the Cluster Terrace of the Zhao king's palace caught fire.

translations.literal: ----6 In autumn, peach and plum trees flowered.
translations.idiomatic: ----6 In autumn, peach and plum trees flowered out of season.

sentences.zh: ----1冬，十一月，呂肅王台薨。

translations.literal: ----1 In winter, the eleventh month, King Su of Lü, Tai, died.
translations.idiomatic: ----1 In winter, the eleventh month, King Su of Lü, Tai, died.

sentences.zh: ----2春，正月，乙卯，地震；

translations.literal: ----2 In spring, the first month, on yimao, there was an earthquake;
translations.idiomatic: ----2 In spring, the first month, on yimao, there was an earthquake;

sentences.zh: 羌道、武都道山崩。

translations.literal: mountains collapsed on the roads at Qiangdao and Wudu.
translations.idiomatic: mountains collapsed on the roads at Qiangdao and Wudu.

sentences.zh: ----3夏，五月，丙申，封楚元王子郢客為上邳侯，齊悼惠王子章為朱虛侯，令入宿衛，又以呂祿女妻章。

translations.literal: ----3 In summer, the fifth month, on bingshen, the son of King Yuan of Chu, Ying Ke, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Shangpi, and the son of King Huaihui of Qi, Zhang, as Marquis of Zhuwei; both were ordered to join the palace guard, and Lü Lu's daughter was also given to Zhang in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: ----3 In summer, the fifth month, on bingshen, Ying Ke, son of King Yuan of Chu, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Shangpi, and Zhang, son of King Huaihui of Qi, as Marquis of Zhuwei; both were ordered into the palace guard, and Lü Lu's daughter was given to Zhang in marriage.

sentences.zh: ----4六月，丙戌晦，日有食之。

translations.literal: ----4 In the sixth month, on the last day bingxu, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: ----4 In the sixth month, on the last day bingxu, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: ----5秋，七月，恆山哀王不疑薨。

translations.literal: ----5 In autumn, the seventh month, King Ai of Hengshan, Buyi, died.
translations.idiomatic: ----5 In autumn, the seventh month, King Ai of Hengshan, Buyi, died.

sentences.zh: ----6行八銖錢。

translations.literal: ----6 Eight-zhu coins were put in circulation.
translations.idiomatic: ----6 Eight-zhu coins were put in circulation.

sentences.zh: ----7癸丑，立襄成侯山為恆山王，更名義。

translations.literal: ----7 On guichou, Marquis of Xiangcheng Shan was installed as king of Hengshan and renamed Yi.
translations.idiomatic: ----7 On guichou, Marquis of Xiangcheng Shan was installed as king of Hengshan and renamed Yi.

sentences.zh: ----1夏，江水、漢水溢，流四千餘家。

translations.literal: ----1 In summer, the Yangtze and Han rivers overflowed, drowning more than four thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: ----1 In summer, the Yangtze and Han overflowed, drowning more than four thousand households.

translations.literal: ----2 In autumn, stars were seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: ----2 In autumn, stars were seen in daytime.

sentences.zh: ----3伊水、洛水溢，流千六百餘家。

translations.literal: ----3 The Yi and Luo rivers overflowed, drowning more than sixteen hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: ----3 The Yi and Luo overflowed, drowning more than sixteen hundred households.

sentences.zh: 汝水溢，流八百餘家。

translations.literal: The Ru River overflowed, drowning more than eight hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: The Ru overflowed, drowning more than eight hundred households.

sentences.zh: ----1春，二月，癸未，立所名孝惠子太為昌平侯。

translations.literal: ----1 In spring, the second month, on guiwei, the son named as Emperor Hui's, Tai, was installed as Marquis of Changping.
translations.idiomatic: ----1 In spring, the second month, on guiwei, the son styled as Emperor Hui's, Tai, was installed as Marquis of Changping.

sentences.zh: ----2夏，四月，丙申，太后封女弟嬃為臨光侯。

translations.literal: ----2 In summer, the fourth month, on bingshen, the Empress Dowager enfeoffed her younger sister by a different mother, Xu, as Marquis of Linguang.
translations.idiomatic: ----2 In summer, the fourth month, on bingshen, the Empress Dowager enfeoffed her younger half-sister Xu as Marquis of Linguang.

sentences.zh: ----3少帝浸長，自知非皇后子，乃出言曰：「-{后}-安能殺吾母而名我？

translations.literal: ----3 The young Emperor was gradually growing up; knowing he was not the empress's son, he spoke out: "-{后}—how could she kill my mother and call me hers?
translations.idiomatic: ----3 The young Emperor was gradually growing up; knowing he was not the empress's son, he spoke out: "-{后}—how could she kill my mother and call me her son?

sentences.zh: 我壯，即為變！

translations.literal: When I am grown, there will be a reckoning!"
translations.idiomatic: When I am grown, there will be a reckoning!"

sentences.zh: 」太后聞之，幽之永巷中，言帝病，左右莫得見。

translations.literal: " When the Empress Dowager heard it, she confined him in the Eternal Lane, announced that the Emperor was ill, and none of his attendants might see him.
translations.idiomatic: " When the Empress Dowager heard it, she confined him in the Eternal Lane, announced that the Emperor was ill, and none of his attendants might see him.

sentences.zh: 太后語群臣曰：「今皇帝病久不已，失惑昏亂，不能繼嗣治天下；

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager told the ministers: "The Emperor has long been ill without recovery; he is muddled and deranged and cannot succeed to rule all under Heaven;
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager told the ministers, "The Emperor has long been ill without recovery; he is muddled and deranged and cannot succeed to rule the realm;

sentences.zh: 其代之。

translations.literal: let him be replaced."
translations.idiomatic: let him be replaced."

sentences.zh: 」群臣皆頓首言：「皇太后為天下齊民計，所以安宗廟、社稷甚深。

translations.literal: " The ministers all bowed their heads and said: "The Empress Dowager has reckoned for the common people of all under Heaven; how deep her means to secure the imperial temples and altars of state.
translations.idiomatic: " The ministers all bowed their heads and said, "The Empress Dowager has reckoned for the common people; how deep her care for the imperial temples and altars of state.

sentences.zh: 群臣頓首奉詔。

translations.literal: The ministers bowed their heads and accepted the decree.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers bowed their heads and accepted the decree.

sentences.zh: 」遂廢帝，幽殺之。

translations.literal: " Thereupon they deposed the Emperor and secretly killed him.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon they deposed the Emperor and killed him in secret.

sentences.zh: 五月，丙辰，立恆山王義為帝，更名曰弘，不稱元年，以太后制天下事故也。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingchen, King Yi of Hengshan was installed as Emperor, renamed Hong; the first year was not proclaimed, because the Empress Dowager governed all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingchen, King Yi of Hengshan was installed as Emperor and renamed Hong; the first year was not proclaimed, because the Empress Dowager governed the realm.

sentences.zh: 以軹侯朝為恆山王。

translations.literal: Marquis of Zhi Chao was made king of Hengshan.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of Zhi Chao was made king of Hengshan.

sentences.zh: ----4是歲，以平陽侯曹窋為御史大夫。

translations.literal: ----4 This year Marquis of Pingyang Cao Chu was made grand secretary.
translations.idiomatic: ----4 This year Marquis of Pingyang Cao Chu was made grand secretary.

sentences.zh: ----5有司請禁南越關市、鐵器。

translations.literal: ----5 The responsible offices requested a ban on market trade and ironware with Nanyue.
translations.idiomatic: ----5 The responsible offices requested a ban on frontier markets and ironware with Nanyue.

sentences.zh: 南越王佗曰：「高帝立我，通使物。

translations.literal: The king of Nanyue, Tuo, said: "The High Emperor installed me and allowed the exchange of envoys and goods.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Nanyue, Tuo, said, "The High Emperor installed me and allowed the exchange of envoys and goods.

sentences.zh: 今高后聽讒臣，別異蠻夷，隔絕器物，此必長沙王計，欲倚中國擊滅南越而並王之，自為功也。

translations.literal: Now the High Empress listens to slanderous ministers, treats the barbarians as separate, and cuts off vessels and tools—this must be the plan of the king of Changsha, who wishes to rely on the central lands to strike down and destroy Nanyue and annex it as king himself, making it his own achievement."
translations.idiomatic: Now the High Empress listens to slanderous ministers, treats the barbarians as alien, and cuts off goods and iron—this must be the king of Changsha's design, to rely on the central court to destroy Nanyue and annex it himself, making that his achievement."

sentences.zh: 1春，佗自稱南越武帝，發兵攻長沙，敗數縣而去。

translations.literal: 1. In spring Tuo styled himself Emperor Wu of Nanyue, sent troops to attack Changsha, defeated several counties, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: 1. In spring Tuo styled himself Emperor Wu of Nanyue, sent troops against Changsha, defeated several counties, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: ----2秋，八月，淮陽懷王強薨，以壺關侯武為淮陽王。

translations.literal: ----2 In autumn, the eighth month, King Huai of Huaiyang, Qiang, died; Marquis of Huguan Wu was made king of Huaiyang.
translations.idiomatic: ----2 In autumn, the eighth month, King Huai of Huaiyang, Qiang, died; Marquis of Huguan Wu was made king of Huaiyang.

sentences.zh: ----3九月，發河東、上黨騎屯北地。

translations.literal: ----3 In the ninth month, cavalry from Hedong and Shangdang were mobilized to garrison Beidi.
translations.idiomatic: ----3 In the ninth month, cavalry from Hedong and Shangdang were mobilized to garrison Beidi.

sentences.zh: ----4初令戍卒歲更。

translations.literal: ----4 For the first time border garrisons were ordered to rotate yearly.
translations.idiomatic: ----4 For the first time border garrisons were ordered to rotate yearly.

sentences.zh: ----1冬，十月，太后以呂王嘉居處驕恣，廢之。

translations.literal: ----1 In winter, the tenth month, the Empress Dowager deposed King Jia of Lü for arrogant and unrestrained conduct in his dwelling.
translations.idiomatic: ----1 In winter, the tenth month, the Empress Dowager deposed King Jia of Lü for arrogant and unrestrained conduct.

sentences.zh: 十一月，立肅王弟產為呂王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, the younger brother of King Su, Chan, was installed as king of Lü.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, the younger brother of King Su, Chan, was installed as king of Lü.

translations.literal: ----2 In spring, stars were seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: ----2 In spring, stars were seen in daytime.

sentences.zh: ----3夏，四月，丁酉，赦天下。

translations.literal: ----3 In summer, the fourth month, on dingyou, all under Heaven was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: ----3 In summer, the fourth month, on dingyou, all under Heaven was pardoned.

sentences.zh: ----4封朱虛侯章弟興居為東牟侯，亦入宿衛。

translations.literal: ----4 Zhang's younger brother Xingju was enfeoffed as Marquis of Dongmou and also joined the palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: ----4 Zhang's younger brother Xingju was enfeoffed as Marquis of Dongmou and also joined the palace guard.

sentences.zh: ----5匈奴寇狄道，攻阿陽。

translations.literal: ----5 The Xiongnu raided Didao and attacked Ayang.
translations.idiomatic: ----5 The Xiongnu raided Didao and attacked Ayang.

sentences.zh: ----6行五分錢。

translations.literal: ----6 Five-fen coins were put in circulation.
translations.idiomatic: ----6 Five-fen coins were put in circulation.

sentences.zh: ----7宣平侯張敖卒，賜謚曰魯元王。

translations.literal: ----7 Marquis of Xuanping Zhang Ao died and was given the posthumous title King Yuan of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: ----7 Marquis of Xuanping Zhang Ao died and was given the posthumous title King Yuan of Lu.

sentences.zh: ----1冬，十二月，匈奴寇狄道，略二千餘人。

translations.literal: ----1 In winter, the twelfth month, the Xiongnu raided Didao and carried off more than two thousand people.
translations.idiomatic: ----1 In winter, the twelfth month, the Xiongnu raided Didao and carried off more than two thousand people.

sentences.zh: ----2春，正月，太后召趙幽王友。

translations.literal: ----2 In spring, the first month, the Empress Dowager summoned King You of Zhao, the Secluded King.
translations.idiomatic: ----2 In spring, the first month, the Empress Dowager summoned King You of Zhao, the Secluded King.

sentences.zh: 友以諸呂女為-{后}-，弗愛，愛他姬。

translations.literal: You had taken a daughter of the Lü clan as -{后}- but did not love her; he loved another consort.
translations.idiomatic: You had taken a daughter of the Lü clan as -{后}- but did not love her; he loved another consort.

sentences.zh: 諸呂女怒，去，讒之於太后曰：「王言『呂氏安得王？

translations.literal: The Lü daughter was enraged, left, and slandered him to the Empress Dowager, saying: "The king said, 'How can the Lü clan be made kings?
translations.idiomatic: The Lü daughter was enraged, left, and slandered him to the Empress Dowager, saying, "The king said, 'How can the Lü clan be made kings?

sentences.zh: 太后百歲後，吾必擊之。

translations.literal: After the Empress Dowager passes her hundred years, I will surely strike them.'"
translations.idiomatic: After the Empress Dowager passes her hundred years, I will surely strike them.'"

sentences.zh: 』」太后以故召趙王，趙王至，置邸，不得見，令衛圍守之，弗與食；

translations.literal: '" For this reason the Empress Dowager summoned the king of Zhao; when the king of Zhao arrived, he was lodged at the guesthouse but could not be received; she ordered guards to surround and hold him and would not give him food;
translations.idiomatic: '" For this reason the Empress Dowager summoned the king of Zhao; when he arrived, he was lodged at the guesthouse but could not be received; she ordered guards to surround him and would not give him food;

sentences.zh: 其群臣或竊饋，輒捕論之。

translations.literal: if any of his ministers secretly fed him, they were immediately seized and prosecuted.
translations.idiomatic: if any of his ministers secretly fed him, they were immediately seized and prosecuted.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，趙王餓死，以民禮葬之長安民塚次。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the king of Zhao starved to death; he was buried with commoners' rites in the commoners' burial ground at Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the king of Zhao starved to death; he was buried with commoners' rites in the commoners' burial ground at Chang'an.

sentences.zh: ----3己丑，日食，晝晦。

translations.literal: ----3 On jichou, there was an eclipse; daytime grew dark.
translations.idiomatic: ----3 On jichou, there was an eclipse; daytime grew dark.

sentences.zh: 太后惡之，謂左右曰：「此為我也！

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager hated it and said to those beside her: "This is on account of me!
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager took it ill and said to those beside her, "This is aimed at me!

sentences.zh: 」----4二月，徙梁王恢為趙王，呂王產為梁王。

translations.literal: " ----4 In the second month, King Hui of Liang was moved to be king of Zhao, and King Chan of Lü was made king of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: " ----4 In the second month, King Hui of Liang was moved to Zhao, and King Chan of Lü was made king of Liang.

sentences.zh: 梁王不之國，為帝太傅。

translations.literal: The king of Liang did not go to his state but became Grand Tutor to the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Liang did not go to his state but became Grand Tutor to the Emperor.

sentences.zh: ----5秋，七月，丁巳，立平昌侯太為濟川王。

translations.literal: ----5 In autumn, the seventh month, on dingsi, Marquis of Pingchang Tai was installed as king of Jichuan.
translations.idiomatic: ----5 In autumn, the seventh month, on dingsi, Marquis of Pingchang Tai was installed as king of Jichuan.

sentences.zh: ----6呂嬃女為將軍、營陵侯劉澤妻。

translations.literal: ----6 Lü Xu had a daughter who was wife to the general and Marquis of Yingling, Liu Ze.
translations.idiomatic: ----6 Lü Xu's daughter was wife to the general and Marquis of Yingling, Liu Ze.

sentences.zh: 澤者，高祖從祖昆弟也。

translations.literal: Ze was a cousin in the collateral line of the High Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Ze was a cousin of the High Ancestor on the collateral line.

sentences.zh: 齊人田生為之說大謁者張卿曰：「諸呂之王也，諸大臣未大服。

translations.literal: The man of Qi, Tian Sheng, spoke on his behalf to the grand usher Zhang Qing, saying: "When the various Lü were made kings, the great ministers were not greatly persuaded.
translations.idiomatic: The man of Qi, Tian Sheng, spoke on his behalf to the grand usher Zhang Qing: "When the Lü were made kings, the great ministers were not fully persuaded.

sentences.zh: 今營陵侯澤，諸劉最長；

translations.literal: Now Marquis of Yingling Ze is the eldest among the various Liu;
translations.idiomatic: Now Marquis of Yingling Ze is the eldest among the Liu;

sentences.zh: 今卿言太后王之，呂氏王益固矣。

translations.literal: if you, sir, speak to the Empress Dowager to make him king, the kingship of the Lü clan would be all the firmer."
translations.idiomatic: if you speak to the Empress Dowager to make him king, the Lü kingship would be all the firmer."

sentences.zh: 」張卿入言太后，太后然之，乃割齊之琅邪郡封澤為琅邪王。

translations.literal: " Zhang Qing entered and spoke to the Empress Dowager; she approved, and therefore cut off the prefecture of Langye in Qi and enfeoffed Ze as king of Langye.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhang Qing went in and spoke to the Empress Dowager; she approved, cut Langye prefecture from Qi, and enfeoffed Ze as king of Langye.

sentences.zh: ----7趙王恢之徙趙，心懷不樂。

translations.literal: ----7 King Hui of Zhao, having been moved to Zhao, harbored discontent in his heart.
translations.idiomatic: ----7 King Hui of Zhao, having been moved to Zhao, was discontent at heart.

sentences.zh: 太后以呂產女為王后，王后從官皆諸呂，擅權，微伺趙王，趙王不得自恣。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager made Lü Chan's daughter his queen; the queen's attendants were all of the Lü clan; they monopolized power, watched the king of Zhao covertly, and the king of Zhao could not act as he wished.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager made Lü Chan's daughter his queen; the queen's attendants were all Lü kin; they monopolized power, watched the king of Zhao covertly, and he could not act as he wished.

sentences.zh: 王有所愛姬，王后使人鴆殺之。

translations.literal: The king had a consort he loved; the queen sent someone to poison her to death.
translations.idiomatic: The king had a consort he loved; the queen sent someone to poison her.

sentences.zh: 六月，王不勝悲憤，自殺。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, unable to bear grief and rage, the king killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, unable to bear grief and rage, the king killed himself.

sentences.zh: 太后聞之，以為王用婦人棄宗廟禮，廢其嗣。

translations.literal: When the Empress Dowager heard it, she held that the king had abandoned the rites of the ancestral temple for a woman's sake and abolished his succession.
translations.idiomatic: When the Empress Dowager heard it, she held that the king had abandoned the rites of the ancestral temple for a woman's sake and abolished his succession.

sentences.zh: ----8是時，諸呂擅權用事。

translations.literal: ----8 At this time the various Lü monopolized power and handled affairs.
translations.idiomatic: ----8 At this time the Lü clan monopolized power and handled affairs.

sentences.zh: 朱虛侯章，年二十，有氣力，忿劉氏不得職。

translations.literal: Marquis of Zhuwei Zhang, twenty years old, had strength and spirit and resented that the Liu clan held no office.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of Zhuwei Zhang, twenty years old, was strong and spirited and resented that the Liu clan held no office.

sentences.zh: 嘗入侍太后燕飲，太后令章為酒吏。

translations.literal: Once, entering to attend the Empress Dowager at a banquet, the Empress Dowager ordered Zhang to be wine steward.
translations.idiomatic: Once, attending the Empress Dowager at a banquet, she ordered Zhang to be wine steward.

sentences.zh: 章自請曰：「臣將種也，請得以軍法行酒。

translations.literal: Zhang requested on his own: "Your servant is of a general's stock; I beg to enforce the wine according to military law.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang requested on his own, "Your servant is of a general's stock; I beg to enforce the wine by military law.

sentences.zh: 」太后曰：「可。

translations.literal: " The Empress Dowager said: "It may be done.
translations.idiomatic: " The Empress Dowager said, "It may be done.

sentences.zh: 」酒酣，章請為《耕田歌》，太后許之。

translations.literal: " When the wine was deep, Zhang requested to perform the "Ploughing Fields Song"; the Empress Dowager granted it.
translations.idiomatic: " When the wine was deep, Zhang requested to perform the "Ploughing Fields Song"; the Empress Dowager granted it.

sentences.zh: 章曰：「深耕穊種，立苗欲疏；

translations.literal: Zhang said: "Plough deep and sow thick; set the seedlings, wanting them sparse;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang said, "Plough deep and sow thick; set the seedlings, wanting them sparse;

sentences.zh: 非其種者，鋤而去之！

translations.literal: What is not our kind—hoe it up and cast it out!
translations.idiomatic: What is not our kind—hoe it up and cast it out!

sentences.zh: 」太后默然。

translations.literal: " The Empress Dowager was silent.
translations.idiomatic: " The Empress Dowager fell silent.

sentences.zh: 頃之，諸呂有一人醉，亡酒，章追，拔劍斬之而還，報曰：「有亡酒一人，臣謹行法斬之！

translations.literal: Shortly after, one of the Lü clan was drunk and fled the wine service; Zhang pursued him, drew his sword and killed him, then returned and reported: "One man fled the wine service; your servant has duly executed him by military law!
translations.idiomatic: Shortly after, one of the Lü clan, drunk, fled the wine service; Zhang pursued him, drew his sword and killed him, then reported: "One man deserted the wine service; your servant has duly executed him by military law!"

sentences.zh: 」太后左右皆大驚，業已許其軍法，無以罪也，因罷。

translations.literal: " Those around the Empress Dowager were all greatly alarmed; she had already approved his military law and could not punish him, and therefore the affair ended.
translations.idiomatic: " Those around the Empress Dowager were greatly alarmed; she had already approved his military law and could not punish him, so the banquet ended.

sentences.zh: 自是之後，諸呂憚朱虛侯，雖大臣皆依朱虛侯，劉氏為益強。

translations.literal: From this time on the Lü clan feared the Marquis of Zhu Xu; even the great ministers all relied on the Marquis of Zhu Xu, and the Liu house grew stronger.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the Lü clan feared the Marquis of Zhu Xu; even the great ministers relied on him, and the Liu house grew stronger.

sentences.zh: 陳平患諸呂，力不能制，恐禍及己。

translations.literal: Chen Ping was troubled by the Lü clan; his strength could not control them, and he feared disaster would reach him.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Ping was troubled by the Lü clan; he lacked the power to control them and feared disaster would reach him.

sentences.zh: 嘗燕居深念，陸賈往，直入坐，而陳丞相不見。

translations.literal: Once when at ease in private he was deep in thought, Lu Jia came; he went straight in and sat down, yet Chancellor Chen did not receive him.
translations.idiomatic: Once when at ease in private he was deep in thought, Lu Jia came, went straight in and sat down, yet Chancellor Chen did not receive him.

sentences.zh: 陸生曰：「何念之深也！

translations.literal: Master Lu said: "How deep your brooding!
translations.idiomatic: Master Lu said, "How deep your brooding!"

sentences.zh: 」陳平曰：「生揣我何念？

translations.literal: " Chen Ping said: "Master, what do you suppose I am brooding on?
translations.idiomatic: " Chen Ping said, "Master, what do you suppose I am brooding on?"

sentences.zh: 」陸生曰：「足下極富貴，無欲矣；

translations.literal: " Master Lu said: "Your Excellency is supremely rich and noble—you have no further wants;
translations.idiomatic: " Master Lu said, "Your Excellency is supremely rich and noble—you want for nothing;

sentences.zh: 然有憂念，不過患諸呂、少主耳。

translations.literal: yet you have a worry, and it is nothing beyond fear of the Lü clan and the young sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: yet you brood on nothing beyond the Lü clan and the young sovereign.

sentences.zh: 」陳平曰：「然！

translations.literal: " Chen Ping said: "It is so!
translations.idiomatic: " Chen Ping said, "It is so!"

sentences.zh: 為之奈何？

translations.literal: What is to be done about it?
translations.idiomatic: What is to be done about it?

sentences.zh: 」陸生曰：「天下安，注意相；

translations.literal: " Master Lu said: "When all under Heaven is secure, attend to the chancellor;
translations.idiomatic: " Master Lu said, "When the realm is secure, attend to the chancellor;

sentences.zh: 天下危，注意將。

translations.literal: when all under Heaven is in peril, attend to the general.
translations.idiomatic: when the realm is in peril, attend to the general.

sentences.zh: 將相和調，則士豫附；

translations.literal: When general and chancellor are in harmony, then officers gladly attach themselves;
translations.idiomatic: When general and chancellor are in harmony, officers gladly attach themselves;

sentences.zh: 天下雖有變，權不分。

translations.literal: though all under Heaven has trouble, power is not divided.
translations.idiomatic: though trouble comes, power is not divided.

sentences.zh: 為社稷計，在兩君掌握耳。

translations.literal: For the altars of soil and grain, it lies in the grasp of you two lords alone.
translations.idiomatic: For the realm's sake, it lies in the grasp of you two lords alone.

sentences.zh: 臣常欲謂太尉絳侯，絳侯與我戲，易吾言。

translations.literal: Your servant has often wished to speak to Grand Commandant the Marquis of Jiang, but the Marquis of Jiang jokes with me and makes light of my words.
translations.idiomatic: I have often wished to speak to Grand Commandant the Marquis of Jiang, but he jokes with me and makes light of my words.

sentences.zh: 君何不交歡太尉，深相結？

translations.literal: Why do you not make friends with the Grand Commandant and bind yourselves deeply?
translations.idiomatic: Why not make friends with the Grand Commandant and bind yourselves deeply?

sentences.zh: 」因為陳平畫呂氏數事。

translations.literal: " He then laid out for Chen Ping several matters concerning the Lü clan.
translations.idiomatic: " He then laid out for Chen Ping several matters concerning the Lü clan.

sentences.zh: 陳平用其計，乃以五百金為絳侯壽，厚具樂飲；

translations.literal: Chen Ping used his plan and therefore sent five hundred in gold as a birthday gift to the Marquis of Jiang, lavishly providing music and drink;
translations.idiomatic: Chen Ping used his plan and sent five hundred in gold as a birthday gift to the Marquis of Jiang, lavishly providing music and drink;

sentences.zh: 太尉報亦如之。

translations.literal: the Grand Commandant returned the courtesy in like measure.
translations.idiomatic: and the Grand Commandant returned the courtesy in like measure.

sentences.zh: 兩人深相結，呂氏謀益衰。

translations.literal: The two men bound themselves deeply, and the Lü clan's plots grew ever weaker.
translations.idiomatic: The two men bound themselves deeply, and the Lü clan's plots grew weaker.

sentences.zh: 陳平以奴婢百人、車馬五十乘、錢五百萬遺陸生為飲食費。

translations.literal: Chen Ping gave Master Lu a hundred slave men and women, fifty teams of chariots and horses, and five million in cash as funds for food and drink.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Ping gave Master Lu a hundred slaves, fifty teams of chariots and horses, and five million in cash for food and drink.

sentences.zh: ----9太后使使告代王，欲徙王趙。

translations.literal: ----9 The Empress Dowager sent envoys to tell the king of Dai that she wished to move his fief to Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: ----9 The Empress Dowager sent envoys to tell the king of Dai that she wished to move his fief to Zhao.

sentences.zh: 代王謝之，願守代邊。

translations.literal: The king of Dai declined and wished to remain guarding the Dai frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Dai declined and wished to remain guarding the Dai frontier.

sentences.zh: 太后乃立兄子呂祿為趙王，追尊祿父建成康侯釋之為趙昭王。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager thereupon installed her elder brother's son Lü Lu as king of Zhao and posthumously honored Lu's father, Marquis Kang of Jiancheng Shi Zhi, as King Zhao of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager thereupon installed her elder brother's son Lü Lu as king of Zhao and posthumously honored Lu's father, Marquis Kang of Jiancheng Shi Zhi, as King Zhao of Zhao.

sentences.zh: ----10九月，燕靈王建薨，有美人子，太后使人殺之。

translations.literal: ----10 In the ninth month King Ling of Yan Jian died; he had a son by a beautiful woman, and the Empress Dowager sent men to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: ----10 In the ninth month King Ling of Yan Jian died; he had a son by a concubine, and the Empress Dowager sent men to kill him.

sentences.zh: 國除。

translations.literal: The state was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The state was abolished.

sentences.zh: ----11遣隆慮侯周灶將兵擊南越。

translations.literal: ----11 The Marquis of Longlu Zhou Zao was sent to lead troops against the Southern Yue.
translations.idiomatic: ----11 The Marquis of Longlu Zhou Zao was sent to lead troops against the Southern Yue.

sentences.zh: ----1冬，十月，辛丑，立呂肅王子東平侯通為燕王，封通弟莊為東平侯。

translations.literal: ----1 In winter, the tenth month, on xinchou, the son of King Su of Lü, Marquis of Dongping Tong, was installed as king of Yan, and Tong's younger brother Zhuang was enfeoffed as Marquis of Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: ----1 In winter, the tenth month, on xinchou, the son of King Su of Lü, Marquis of Dongping Tong, was installed as king of Yan, and Tong's younger brother Zhuang was enfeoffed as Marquis of Dongping.

sentences.zh: ----2三月，太后祓，還，過軹道，見物如蒼犬，撠太后掖，忽不復見。

translations.literal: ----2 In the third month the Empress Dowager performed the lustration rite; on her return, passing Zhi Road, she saw something like a gray dog that struck her under the arm, then suddenly was seen no more.
translations.idiomatic: ----2 In the third month the Empress Dowager performed the lustration rite; on her return, passing Zhi Road, she saw something like a gray dog that struck her under the arm, then vanished.

sentences.zh: 卜之，云「趙王如意為祟」。

translations.literal: She divined about it; the answer said: "King Ruyi of Zhao is the haunting spirit."
translations.idiomatic: She divined; the answer said, "King Ruyi of Zhao is the haunting spirit."

sentences.zh: 太后遂病掖傷。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager then fell ill from the wound to her arm.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager then fell ill from the wound to her arm.

sentences.zh: 太后為外孫魯王偃年少孤弱，夏，四月，丁酉，封張敖前姬兩子侈為新都侯，壽為樂昌侯，以輔魯王。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager, because her grandson the king of Lu Yan was young, orphaned, and weak, in summer, the fourth month, on dingyou, enfeoffed Zhang Ao's two sons by a former concubine—Zhang Chi as Marquis of Xindu and Zhang Shou as Marquis of Lechang—to assist the king of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: Because her grandson the king of Lu Yan was young, orphaned, and weak, in summer, the fourth month, on dingyou, she enfeoffed Zhang Ao's two sons by a former concubine—Zhang Chi as Marquis of Xindu and Zhang Shou as Marquis of Lechang—to assist the king of Lu.

sentences.zh: 又封中大謁者張釋為建陵侯，以其勸王諸呂，賞之也。

translations.literal: She also enfeoffed the grand usher Zhang Shi as Marquis of Jianling, rewarding him for having urged the king to support the Lü clan.
translations.idiomatic: She also enfeoffed the grand usher Zhang Shi as Marquis of Jianling, rewarding him for having urged the king to support the Lü clan.

sentences.zh: ----3江、漢水溢，流萬餘家。

translations.literal: ----3 The Yangzi and Han rivers overflowed, drowning more than ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: ----3 The Yangzi and Han rivers overflowed, drowning more than ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: ----4秋，七月，太后病甚，乃令趙王祿為上將軍，居北軍；

translations.literal: ----4 In autumn, the seventh month, the Empress Dowager was gravely ill and therefore appointed King Zhao Lu as supreme general and stationed him in the Northern Army;
translations.idiomatic: ----4 In autumn, the seventh month, the Empress Dowager was gravely ill and appointed King Zhao Lu as supreme general in the Northern Army;

sentences.zh: 呂王產居南軍。

translations.literal: King Lü Chan was stationed in the Southern Army.
translations.idiomatic: King Lü Chan was stationed in the Southern Army.

sentences.zh: 太后誡產、祿曰：「呂氏之王，大臣弗平。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager admonished Chan and Lu, saying: "The kingship of the Lü clan—the great ministers are not reconciled.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager admonished Chan and Lu: "The Lü kingships—the great ministers are not reconciled.

sentences.zh: 我即崩，帝年少，大臣恐為變。

translations.literal: When I soon die, the Emperor is young, and the great ministers may fear trouble.
translations.idiomatic: When I soon die, the Emperor is young, and the great ministers may fear trouble.

sentences.zh: 必據兵衛宮，慎毋送喪，為人所制！

translations.literal: You must hold troops and guard the palace; take care not to attend the funeral—you will be controlled by others!
translations.idiomatic: You must hold troops and guard the palace; take care not to attend the funeral—you will be controlled by others!"

sentences.zh: 」辛巳，太后崩，遺詔：大赦天下，以呂王產為相國，以呂祿女為帝后。

translations.literal: " On xinsi the Empress Dowager died; her testamentary edict: a general amnesty for all under Heaven; King Lü Chan to be Chancellor of State; Lü Lu's daughter to be empress.
translations.idiomatic: " On xinsi the Empress Dowager died. Her testamentary edict: a general amnesty; King Lü Chan to be Chancellor of State; Lü Lu's daughter to be empress.

sentences.zh: 高後已葬，以左丞相審食其為帝太傅。

translations.literal: After the High Empress Dowager was buried, the left chancellor Shen Yiji was made Imperial Tutor to the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: After the High Empress Dowager was buried, the left chancellor Shen Yiji was made Imperial Tutor to the Emperor.

sentences.zh: ----5諸呂欲為亂，畏大臣絳、灌等，未敢發。

translations.literal: ----5 The Lü clan wished to make rebellion but feared the great ministers Jiang, Guan, and others, and did not dare act.
translations.idiomatic: ----5 The Lü clan wished to rebel but feared the great ministers Jiang, Guan, and others, and did not dare act.

sentences.zh: 朱虛侯以呂祿女為婦，故知其謀，乃陰令人告其兄齊王，欲令發兵西，朱虛侯、東牟侯為內應，以誅諸呂，立齊王為帝。

translations.literal: The Marquis of Zhu Xu, because he had taken Lü Lu's daughter as wife, therefore knew their plot; he secretly sent men to tell his elder brother the king of Qi, wishing him to raise troops and march west while the Marquis of Zhu Xu and the Marquis of Dongmou served as inner supporters, to execute the Lü clan and install the king of Qi as emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The Marquis of Zhu Xu, having married Lü Lu's daughter, knew their plot; he secretly sent men to tell his elder brother the king of Qi to raise troops and march west while the Marquis of Zhu Xu and the Marquis of Dongmou served as inner supporters, to execute the Lü clan and install the king of Qi as emperor.

sentences.zh: 齊王乃與其舅駟鈞、郎中令祝午、中尉魏勃陰謀發兵。

translations.literal: The king of Qi then secretly plotted to raise troops with his maternal uncle Si Jun, the director of attendants Zhu Wu, and the commandant of justice Wei Bo.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Qi then secretly plotted to raise troops with his maternal uncle Si Jun, the director of attendants Zhu Wu, and the commandant of justice Wei Bo.

sentences.zh: 齊相召平弗聽。

translations.literal: The chancellor of Qi, Shao Ping, would not heed him.
translations.idiomatic: The chancellor of Qi, Shao Ping, would not heed him.

sentences.zh: 八月，丙午，齊王欲使人誅相。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on bingwu, the king of Qi wished to send men to execute the chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingwu, the king of Qi wished to send men to execute the chancellor.

sentences.zh: 相聞之，乃發卒衛王宮。

translations.literal: The chancellor, learning of it, then raised troops to guard the royal palace.
translations.idiomatic: The chancellor, learning of it, raised troops to guard the royal palace.

sentences.zh: 魏勃紿召平曰：「王欲發兵，非有漢虎符驗也。

translations.literal: Wei Bo deceived Shao Ping, saying: "The king wishes to raise troops, yet there is no verification by the Han tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Bo deceived Shao Ping: "The king wishes to raise troops, yet there is no verification by the Han tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 而相君圍王固善，勃請為君將兵衛王。

translations.literal: Yet my lord the chancellor in besieging the king is surely right; Bo asks to lead troops for my lord and guard the king.
translations.idiomatic: Yet my lord the chancellor in besieging the king is surely right; Bo asks to lead troops for my lord and guard the king."

sentences.zh: 」召平信之。

translations.literal: " Shao Ping believed him.
translations.idiomatic: " Shao Ping believed him.

sentences.zh: 勃既將兵，遂圍相府，召平自殺。

translations.literal: Once Bo had taken command of the troops, he then besieged the chancellor's residence and Shao Ping killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: Once Bo had taken command, he besieged the chancellor's residence and Shao Ping killed himself.

sentences.zh: 於是齊王以駟鈞為相，魏勃為將軍，祝午為內史，悉發國中兵。

translations.literal: Thereupon the king of Qi made Si Jun chancellor, Wei Bo general, and Zhu Wu director of the interior, and fully mobilized the state's troops.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the king of Qi made Si Jun chancellor, Wei Bo general, and Zhu Wu director of the interior, and fully mobilized the state's troops.

sentences.zh: 使祝午東詐琅邪王曰：「呂氏作亂，齊王發兵欲西誅之。

translations.literal: He sent Zhu Wu east to deceive the king of Langye, saying: "The Lü clan is in rebellion; the king of Qi has raised troops and wishes to march west to execute them.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Zhu Wu east to deceive the king of Langye: "The Lü clan is in rebellion; the king of Qi has raised troops and wishes to march west to execute them.

sentences.zh: 齊王自以年少，不習兵革之事，願舉國委大王。

translations.literal: The king of Qi considers himself young and unskilled in military affairs, and wishes to entrust the whole state to Your Majesty.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Qi considers himself young and unskilled in military affairs and wishes to entrust the whole state to Your Majesty.

sentences.zh: 大王，自高帝將也。

translations.literal: Your Majesty was yourself a general under High Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty was yourself a general under the High Emperor.

sentences.zh: 請大王幸之臨菑，見齊王計事。

translations.literal: We beg Your Majesty to favor us with a visit to Linzi to meet the king of Qi and plan affairs.
translations.idiomatic: We beg Your Majesty to favor us with a visit to Linzi to meet the king of Qi and plan affairs."

sentences.zh: 」琅邪王信之，西馳見齊王。

translations.literal: " The king of Langye believed it and galloped west to see the king of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: " The king of Langye believed it and galloped west to see the king of Qi.

sentences.zh: 齊王因留琅邪王，而使祝午盡發琅邪國兵，並將之。

translations.literal: The king of Qi thereupon detained the king of Langye and sent Zhu Wu to fully mobilize the troops of the state of Langye and take joint command of them.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Qi detained the king of Langye and sent Zhu Wu to fully mobilize Langye's troops and take joint command.

sentences.zh: 琅邪王說齊王曰：「大王，高皇帝適長孫也，當立。

translations.literal: The king of Langye persuaded the king of Qi, saying: "Your Majesty, as the eldest grandson by the proper wife of High Emperor, ought to be enthroned.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Langye persuaded the king of Qi: "Your Majesty, as the eldest grandson by the proper wife of the High Emperor, ought to be enthroned.

sentences.zh: 今諸大臣狐疑未有所定，而澤於劉氏最為長年，大臣固待澤決計。

translations.literal: Now the great ministers are in doubt and have not settled on anyone, and among the Liu house Ze is the eldest in years; the great ministers surely await Ze to decide the plan.
translations.idiomatic: Now the great ministers are in doubt and have not settled on anyone; among the Liu house Ze is the eldest in years, and the great ministers surely await Ze to decide.

sentences.zh: 今大王留臣，無為也，不如使我入關計事。

translations.literal: Now if Your Majesty detains your servant, it is of no use; better to let your servant enter the passes and plan affairs.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty detains me, it is of no use; better to let me enter the passes and plan affairs."

sentences.zh: 」齊王以為然，乃益具車送琅邪王。

translations.literal: " The king of Qi thought it right and therefore further equipped chariots and sent off the king of Langye.
translations.idiomatic: " The king of Qi thought it right and further equipped chariots and sent off the king of Langye.

sentences.zh: 琅邪王既行，齊遂舉兵西攻濟南。

translations.literal: Once the king of Langye had departed, Qi thereupon raised troops and attacked Jinan westward.
translations.idiomatic: Once the king of Langye had departed, Qi raised troops and attacked Jinan westward.

sentences.zh: 遺諸侯王書，陳諸呂之罪，欲舉兵誅之。

translations.literal: He sent a letter to the feudal kings, setting forth the crimes of the Lü clan and wishing to raise troops to execute them.
translations.idiomatic: He sent a letter to the feudal kings, setting forth the crimes of the Lü clan and wishing to raise troops to execute them.

sentences.zh: 相國呂產等聞之，乃遣穎陰侯灌嬰將兵擊之。

translations.literal: Chancellor of State Lü Chan and others, hearing of it, then sent the Marquis of Yingyin Guan Ying to lead troops against them.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor of State Lü Chan and others, hearing of it, sent the Marquis of Yingyin Guan Ying to lead troops against them.

sentences.zh: 灌嬰至滎陽，謀曰：「諸呂擁兵關中，欲危劉氏而自立。

translations.literal: Guan Ying reached Xingyang and took counsel, saying: "The Lü clan hold troops in the passes and wish to endanger the Liu house and set themselves up.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Ying reached Xingyang and took counsel: "The Lü clan hold troops in the passes and wish to endanger the Liu house and set themselves up.

sentences.zh: 今我破齊還報，此益呂氏之資也。

translations.literal: If I now break Qi and return to report, this only adds to the Lü clan's resources.
translations.idiomatic: If I now break Qi and return to report, this only adds to the Lü clan's resources."

sentences.zh: 」乃留屯滎陽，使使諭齊王及諸侯與連和，以待呂氏變，共誅之。

translations.literal: " He therefore remained encamped at Xingyang, sent envoys to instruct the king of Qi and the feudal lords to join in alliance, and waited for trouble from the Lü clan so they might together execute them.
translations.idiomatic: " He therefore remained encamped at Xingyang, sent envoys to instruct the king of Qi and the feudal lords to join in alliance, and waited for trouble from the Lü clan so they might together execute them.

sentences.zh: 齊王聞之，乃還兵西界待約。

translations.literal: The king of Qi, hearing of it, then returned his troops to the western border to await the covenant.
translations.idiomatic: The king of Qi, hearing of it, returned his troops to the western border to await the covenant.

sentences.zh: 呂祿、呂產欲作亂，內憚絳侯、朱虛等，外畏齊、楚兵，又恐灌嬰畔之。

translations.literal: Lü Lu and Lü Chan wished to make rebellion; inwardly they feared the Marquis of Jiang, the Marquis of Zhu Xu, and others; outwardly they feared the troops of Qi and Chu; and they also feared Guan Ying would turn against them.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Lu and Lü Chan wished to rebel; inwardly they feared the Marquis of Jiang, the Marquis of Zhu Xu, and others; outwardly they feared the troops of Qi and Chu; and they also feared Guan Ying would turn against them.

sentences.zh: 欲待灌嬰兵與齊合而發，猶豫未決。

translations.literal: They wished to wait until Guan Ying's troops joined with Qi's before acting, and hesitated without deciding.
translations.idiomatic: They wished to wait until Guan Ying's troops joined with Qi's before acting, and hesitated without deciding.

sentences.zh: 當是時，濟川王太、淮陽王武、常山王朝及魯王張偃皆年少，未之國，居長安；

translations.literal: At this time the kings of Jichuan Tai, Huaiyang Wu, Changshan Chao, and Lu Zhang Yan were all young and had not gone to their states, dwelling in Chang'an;
translations.idiomatic: At this time the kings of Jichuan Tai, Huaiyang Wu, Changshan Chao, and Lu Zhang Yan were all young and had not gone to their states, dwelling in Chang'an;

sentences.zh: 趙王祿、梁王產各將兵居南、北軍。

translations.literal: King Zhao Lu and King Liang Chan each commanded troops stationed in the Southern and Northern Armies.
translations.idiomatic: King Zhao Lu and King Liang Chan each commanded troops in the Southern and Northern Armies.

sentences.zh: 皆呂氏之人也。

translations.literal: all were men of the Lü clan.
translations.idiomatic: all were men of the Lü clan.

sentences.zh: 列侯群臣莫自堅其命。

translations.literal: The ranked marquises and the host of ministers none could be secure in their lives.
translations.idiomatic: The ranked marquises and ministers none could be secure in their lives.

sentences.zh: 太尉絳侯勃不得主兵。

translations.literal: Grand Commandant the Marquis of Jiang Bo could not command troops.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commandant the Marquis of Jiang Bo could not command troops.

sentences.zh: 曲周侯酈商老病，其子寄與呂祿善。

translations.literal: The Marquis of Quzhou Li Shang was old and ill; his son Ji was on good terms with Lü Lu.
translations.idiomatic: The Marquis of Quzhou Li Shang was old and ill; his son Ji was on good terms with Lü Lu.

sentences.zh: 絳侯乃與丞相陳平謀，使人劫酈商，令其子寄往紿說呂祿曰：「高帝與-{呂后}-共定天下，劉氏所立九王，呂氏所立三王，皆大臣之議，事已佈告諸侯，皆以為宜。

translations.literal: The Marquis of Jiang then plotted with Chancellor Chen Ping, sent men to seize Li Shang, and had his son Ji go to deceive and persuade Lü Lu, saying: "High Emperor and -{呂后}- together settled all under Heaven; the nine kings the Liu house installed and the three kings the Lü house installed were all by the great ministers' deliberation; the matter has already been proclaimed to the feudal lords, and all think it fitting.
translations.idiomatic: The Marquis of Jiang then plotted with Chancellor Chen Ping, sent men to seize Li Shang, and had his son Ji go to deceive Lü Lu: "The High Emperor and -{呂后}- together settled the realm; the nine kings the Liu house installed and the three the Lü house installed were all by the great ministers' deliberation; the matter has been proclaimed to the feudal lords, and all think it fitting.

sentences.zh: 今太后崩，帝少，而足下佩趙王印，不急之國守籓，乃為上將，將兵留此，為大臣諸侯所疑。

translations.literal: Now the Empress Dowager is dead and the Emperor young, yet Your Excellency wears the seal of king of Zhao, does not hurry to your state to guard your fief, but instead serves as supreme general and keeps troops here—you are suspected by the great ministers and feudal lords.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Empress Dowager is dead and the Emperor young, yet Your Excellency wears the seal of king of Zhao, does not hurry to your state to guard your fief, but serves as supreme general and keeps troops here—you are suspected by the great ministers and feudal lords.

sentences.zh: 足下何不歸將印，以兵屬太尉，請梁王歸相國印，與大臣盟而之國。

translations.literal: Why does Your Excellency not return the general's seal and entrust the troops to the Grand Commandant, ask King Liang to return the Chancellor of State's seal, covenant with the great ministers, and go to your states?
translations.idiomatic: Why not return the general's seal and entrust the troops to the Grand Commandant, ask King Liang to return the Chancellor of State's seal, covenant with the great ministers, and go to your states?

sentences.zh: 齊兵必罷，大臣得安，足下高枕而王千里，此萬世之利也。

translations.literal: Qi's troops will surely be dismissed, the great ministers will be secure, and Your Excellency may lay your head on a high pillow and be king of a thousand li—this is a benefit for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: Qi's troops will surely be dismissed, the great ministers will be secure, and you may lay your head on a high pillow and be king of a thousand li—this is a benefit for ten thousand generations."

sentences.zh: 」呂祿信然其計，欲以兵屬太尉。

translations.literal: " Lü Lu believed this plan was so and wished to entrust the troops to the Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: " Lü Lu believed this plan and wished to entrust the troops to the Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 使人報呂產及諸呂老人，或以為便，或曰不便，計猶豫未有所決。

translations.literal: He sent men to report to Lü Chan and the elders of the Lü clan; some thought it expedient, some said it was not expedient—the plan hesitated without decision.
translations.idiomatic: He sent men to report to Lü Chan and the elders of the Lü clan; some thought it expedient, some said it was not—the plan hesitated without decision.

sentences.zh: 呂祿信酈寄，時與出遊獵，過其姑呂嬃。

translations.literal: Lü Lu trusted Li Ji and at times went out with him to hunt, passing his aunt Lü Xu.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Lu trusted Li Ji and at times went out with him to hunt, passing his aunt Lü Xu.

sentences.zh: 嬃大怒曰：「若為將而棄軍，呂氏今無處矣！

translations.literal: Xu raged and said: "You serve as general yet abandon the army—the Lü clan today has nowhere to stand!
translations.idiomatic: Xu raged: "You serve as general yet abandon the army—the Lü clan today has nowhere to stand!"

sentences.zh: 」乃悉出珠玉、寶器散堂下，曰：「毋為他人守也！

translations.literal: " She then brought out all pearls and jade and precious vessels and scattered them in the hall, saying: "Do not keep them for others!
translations.idiomatic: " She then brought out all pearls, jade, and precious vessels and scattered them in the hall: "Do not keep them for others!"

sentences.zh: 九月，庚申旦，平陽侯窋行御史大夫事，見相國產計事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, at dawn on gengshen, the Marquis of Pingyang Zhu, acting as Grand Secretary, met Chancellor of State Chan to plan affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, at dawn on gengshen, the Marquis of Pingyang Zhu, acting as Grand Secretary, met Chancellor of State Chan to plan affairs.

sentences.zh: 郎中令賈壽使從齊來，因數產曰：「王不早之國，今雖欲行，尚可得邪！

translations.literal: Director of attendants Jia Shou's envoy came from Qi and therefore reproached Chan, saying: "Your Majesty did not go early to your state; though you now wish to go, can you still get away!
translations.idiomatic: Director of attendants Jia Shou's envoy came from Qi and reproached Chan: "Your Majesty did not go early to your state; though you now wish to go, can you still get away!"

sentences.zh: 」具以灌嬰與齊、楚合從欲誅諸呂告產，且趣產急入宮。

translations.literal: " He fully told Chan that Guan Ying had joined in horizontal alliance with Qi and Chu and wished to execute the Lü clan, and urged Chan to hurry into the palace.
translations.idiomatic: " He fully told Chan that Guan Ying had allied with Qi and Chu and wished to execute the Lü clan, and urged Chan to hurry into the palace.

sentences.zh: 平陽侯頗聞其語，馳告丞相、太尉。

translations.literal: The Marquis of Pingyang had partly overheard these words and galloped to tell the chancellor and Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: The Marquis of Pingyang had partly overheard these words and galloped to tell the chancellor and Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 太尉欲入北軍，不得入。

translations.literal: The Grand Commandant wished to enter the Northern Army but could not enter.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Commandant wished to enter the Northern Army but could not enter.

sentences.zh: 襄平侯紀通尚符節，乃令持節矯內太尉北軍。

translations.literal: The Marquis of Xiangping Ji Tong held the tally and credentials; he was therefore ordered to hold the credentials and falsely announce the Grand Commandant's entry into the Northern Army.
translations.idiomatic: The Marquis of Xiangping Ji Tong held the tally and credentials; he was ordered to hold the credentials and falsely announce the Grand Commandant's entry into the Northern Army.

sentences.zh: 太尉復令酈寄與典客劉揭先說呂祿曰：「帝使太尉守北軍，欲足下之國。

translations.literal: The Grand Commandant again ordered Li Ji and the director of guests Liu Jie first to persuade Lü Lu, saying: "The Emperor has sent the Grand Commandant to hold the Northern Army and wishes Your Excellency to go to your state.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Commandant again ordered Li Ji and the director of guests Liu Jie first to persuade Lü Lu: "The Emperor has sent the Grand Commandant to hold the Northern Army and wishes you to go to your state.

sentences.zh: 急歸將印辭去。

translations.literal: Hurry back and return the general's seal and resign.
translations.idiomatic: Hurry back and return the general's seal and resign.

sentences.zh: 不然，禍且起。

translations.literal: If not, disaster will soon arise.
translations.idiomatic: If not, disaster will soon arise."

sentences.zh: 」呂祿以為酈況不欺己，遂解印屬典客，而以兵授太尉。

translations.literal: " Lü Lu thought Li Ji would not deceive him, thereupon removed the seal and entrusted it to the director of guests, and gave the troops to the Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: " Lü Lu thought Li Ji would not deceive him, removed the seal and entrusted it to the director of guests, and gave the troops to the Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 太尉至軍，呂祿已去。

translations.literal: The Grand Commandant reached the army; Lü Lu had already left.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Commandant reached the army; Lü Lu had already left.

sentences.zh: 太尉入軍門，行令軍中曰：「為呂氏右袒，為劉氏左袒！

translations.literal: The Grand Commandant entered the camp gate and issued orders in the army, saying: "Those for the house of Lü, bare the right shoulder; those for the house of Liu, bare the left shoulder!
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Commandant entered the camp gate and issued orders in the army: "Those for the house of Lü, bare the right shoulder; those for the house of Liu, bare the left shoulder!"

sentences.zh: 」軍中皆左袒，太尉遂將北軍。

translations.literal: " In the army all bared the left shoulder; the Grand Commandant then took command of the Northern Army.
translations.idiomatic: " In the army all bared the left shoulder; the Grand Commandant then took command of the Northern Army.

sentences.zh: 然尚有南軍。

translations.literal: Yet the Southern Army still remained.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Southern Army still remained.

sentences.zh: 丞相平乃召朱虛侯章佐太尉，太尉令朱虛侯監軍門，令平陽侯告衛尉：「毋入相國產殿門。

translations.literal: Chancellor Ping then summoned the Marquis of Zhu Xu, Zhang, to assist the Grand Commandant; the Grand Commandant ordered the Marquis of Zhu Xu to supervise the camp gate and ordered the Marquis of Pingyang to tell the Commandant of the Guard: "Do not let anyone enter Chancellor of State Chan's palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: Chancellor Ping then summoned the Marquis of Zhu Xu, Zhang, to assist the Grand Commandant; the Grand Commandant ordered the Marquis of Zhu Xu to supervise the camp gate and ordered the Marquis of Pingyang to tell the Commandant of the Guard: "Do not let anyone enter Chancellor of State Chan's palace gate."

sentences.zh: 呂產不知呂祿已去北軍，乃入未央宮，欲為亂。

translations.literal: Lü Chan did not know Lü Lu had already left the Northern Army; he entered Weiyang Palace, intending to make trouble.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Chan did not know Lü Lu had already left the Northern Army; he entered Weiyang Palace, intending to make trouble.

sentences.zh: 至殿門，弗得入，徘徊往來。

translations.literal: Reaching the palace gate, he could not enter and paced back and forth.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching the palace gate, he could not enter and paced back and forth.

sentences.zh: 平陽侯恐弗勝，馳語太尉。

translations.literal: The Marquis of Pingyang feared they would not prevail and galloped to tell the Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: The Marquis of Pingyang feared they would not prevail and galloped to tell the Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 太尉尚恐不勝諸呂，未敢公言誅之，乃謂朱虛侯曰：「急入宮衛帝！

translations.literal: The Grand Commandant still feared he might not overcome the various Lü and did not dare speak openly of executing them; he said to the Marquis of Zhu Xu: "Hurry into the palace and guard the Emperor!
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Commandant still feared he might not overcome the various Lü and did not dare speak openly of executing them; he said to the Marquis of Zhu Xu: "Hurry into the palace and guard the Emperor!"

sentences.zh: 」朱虛侯請卒，太尉予卒千餘人。

translations.literal: " The Marquis of Zhu Xu requested troops; the Grand Commandant gave him more than a thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: " The Marquis of Zhu Xu requested troops; the Grand Commandant gave him more than a thousand men.

sentences.zh: 入未央宮門，見產廷中。

translations.literal: Entering Weiyang Palace gate, he saw Chan in the courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: Entering Weiyang Palace gate, he saw Chan in the courtyard.

sentences.zh: 日哺時，遂擊產，產走。

translations.literal: At the hour of shen he attacked Chan; Chan fled.
translations.idiomatic: In late afternoon he attacked Chan; Chan fled.

sentences.zh: 天風大起，以故其從官亂，莫敢鬬，逐產，殺之郎中府吏廁中。

translations.literal: A great wind arose; for this reason his followers fell into disorder, none daring to fight; they pursued Chan and killed him in the privy of the Palace Attendant's quarters.
translations.idiomatic: A great wind arose; his followers fell into disorder and none dared fight; they pursued Chan and killed him in the privy of the Palace Attendant's quarters.

sentences.zh: 朱虛侯已殺產，帝命謁者持節勞朱虛侯。

translations.literal: After the Marquis of Zhu Xu had killed Chan, the Emperor ordered a chamberlain to hold credentials of authority and console the Marquis of Zhu Xu.
translations.idiomatic: After the Marquis of Zhu Xu had killed Chan, the Emperor ordered a chamberlain to hold credentials of authority and console the Marquis of Zhu Xu.

sentences.zh: 朱虛侯欲奪其節，謁者不肯。

translations.literal: The Marquis of Zhu Xu wished to seize the credentials; the chamberlain would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: The Marquis of Zhu Xu wished to seize the credentials; the chamberlain would not agree.

sentences.zh: 朱虛侯則從與載，因節信馳走，斬長樂衛尉呂更始。

translations.literal: The Marquis of Zhu Xu then went along with him in the carriage; relying on the credentials' authority he galloped off and beheaded Chang Palace Commandant of the Guard Lü Gengshi.
translations.idiomatic: The Marquis of Zhu Xu then rode with him in the carriage; relying on the credentials' authority he galloped off and beheaded Chang Palace Commandant of the Guard Lü Gengshi.

sentences.zh: 還，馳入北軍報太尉。

translations.literal: Returning, he galloped into the Northern Army to report to the Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Returning, he galloped into the Northern Army to report to the Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 太尉起，拜賀朱虛侯曰：「所患獨呂產。

translations.literal: The Grand Commandant rose, bowed in congratulation to the Marquis of Zhu Xu, and said: "The sole worry was Lü Chan.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Commandant rose, bowed in congratulation to the Marquis of Zhu Xu, and said: "The sole worry was Lü Chan.

sentences.zh: 今已誅，天下定矣！

translations.literal: Now he has been executed—all under Heaven is settled!
translations.idiomatic: Now he has been executed—the realm is settled!

sentences.zh: 」遂遣人分部悉捕諸呂男女，無少長皆斬之。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he sent men in divisions to arrest all the Lü, men and women; none, young or old, was spared execution.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon he sent men in divisions to arrest all the Lü, men and women; none, young or old, was spared execution.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，捕斬呂祿而笞殺呂嬃，使人誅燕王呂通而廢魯王張偃。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Lü Lu was captured and executed and Lü Xu was flogged to death; envoys were sent to execute King of Yan Lü Tong and depose King of Lu Zhang Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Lü Lu was captured and executed and Lü Xu was flogged to death; envoys were sent to execute King of Yan Lü Tong and depose King of Lu Zhang Yan.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，徙濟川王王梁。

translations.literal: On wuchen, the King of Jichuan was moved to be King of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, the King of Jichuan was moved to be King of Liang.

sentences.zh: 遣朱虛侯章以誅諸呂事告齊王，令罷兵。

translations.literal: The Marquis of Zhu Xu, Zhang, was sent to report to the King of Qi about the execution of the Lü and to order him to disband his troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Marquis of Zhu Xu, Zhang, was sent to report to the King of Qi about the execution of the Lü and to order him to disband his troops.

sentences.zh: 灌嬰在滎陽，聞魏勃本教齊王舉兵，使使召魏勃至，責問之。

translations.literal: Guan Ying was at Xingyang; hearing that Wei Bo had originally urged the King of Qi to raise troops, he sent an envoy to summon Wei Bo; when he arrived, Guan rebuked and questioned him.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Ying was at Xingyang; hearing that Wei Bo had originally urged the King of Qi to raise troops, he sent an envoy to summon Wei Bo and, when he arrived, rebuked and questioned him.

sentences.zh: 勃曰：「失火之家，豈暇先言丈人而後救火乎！

translations.literal: Bo said: "In a house where fire has broken out, how could there be leisure to speak first of the father-in-law and only then fight the fire!
translations.idiomatic: Bo said: "In a house where fire has broken out, how could there be leisure to speak first of the father-in-law and only then fight the fire!"

sentences.zh: 」因退立，股戰而栗，恐不能言者，終無他語。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he withdrew and stood aside, thighs trembling and shuddering, afraid he could not speak; in the end he said nothing more.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon he withdrew and stood aside, thighs trembling and shuddering, afraid he could not speak; in the end he said nothing more.

sentences.zh: 灌將軍熟視笑曰：「人謂魏勃勇，妄庸人耳，何能為乎！

translations.literal: General Guan looked at him intently and laughed, saying: "People call Wei Bo brave—he is a muddled common fellow; what can he do!
translations.idiomatic: General Guan looked at him intently and laughed: "People call Wei Bo brave—he is a muddled common fellow; what can he do!"

sentences.zh: 」乃罷魏勃。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he dismissed Wei Bo.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon he dismissed Wei Bo.

sentences.zh: 灌嬰兵亦罷滎陽歸。

translations.literal: Guan Ying's troops also withdrew from Xingyang and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Guan Ying's troops also withdrew from Xingyang and returned.

sentences.zh: ::班固贊曰：孝文時，天下以酈寄為賣友。

translations.literal: :: Ban Gu's encomium says: In Emperor Wen's time, all under Heaven took Li Ji as one who sold out his friend.
translations.idiomatic: :: Ban Gu's encomium says: In Emperor Wen's time, all under Heaven took Li Ji as one who sold out his friend.

sentences.zh: 夫賣友者，謂見利而忘義也。

translations.literal: To sell out a friend means to see profit and forget righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: To sell out a friend means to see profit and forget righteousness.

sentences.zh: 若寄父為功臣而又執劫，雖摧呂祿以安社稷，誼存君親可也。

translations.literal: If Ji, as the son of a meritorious minister, moreover held him hostage, though he overthrew Lü Lu to secure the altars of soil and grain, it was permissible to preserve lord and kin in righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: If Ji, as the son of a meritorious minister, moreover held him hostage, though he overthrew Lü Lu to secure the realm, it was permissible to preserve lord and kin in righteousness.

sentences.zh: ----6諸大臣相與陰謀曰：「少帝及梁、淮陽、恆山王，皆非真孝惠子也。

translations.literal: ----6 The great ministers together plotted in secret, saying: "The Young Emperor and the kings of Liang, Huaiyang, and Hengshan are none of them true sons of Emperor Xiaohui.
translations.idiomatic: ----6 The great ministers together plotted in secret: "The Young Emperor and the kings of Liang, Huaiyang, and Hengshan are none of them true sons of Emperor Xiaohui.

sentences.zh: -{呂后}-以計詐名他人子，殺其母養後宮，令孝惠子之，立以為後及諸王，以強呂氏。

translations.literal: -{呂后}- by scheme falsely named others' sons, killed their mothers, and raised them in the rear palace, making Emperor Xiaohui's sons of them, establishing one as heir and the various kings, to strengthen the house of Lü.
translations.idiomatic: -{呂后}- by scheme falsely named others' sons, killed their mothers, and raised them in the rear palace, making them Emperor Xiaohui's sons, establishing one as heir and the various kings, to strengthen the house of Lü.

sentences.zh: 今皆已夷滅諸呂，而所立即長，用事，吾屬無類矣。

translations.literal: Now all the Lü have been exterminated, yet the one enthroned is grown and in power—our sort will have no survivors.
translations.idiomatic: Now all the Lü have been exterminated, yet the one enthroned is grown and in power—our sort will have no survivors.

sentences.zh: 不如視諸王最賢者立之。

translations.literal: Better to look among the kings for the most worthy and establish him.
translations.idiomatic: Better to look among the kings for the most worthy and establish him.

sentences.zh: 」或言：「齊王，高帝長孫，可立也。

translations.literal: " Some said: "The King of Qi, the High Emperor's eldest grandson, may be established.
translations.idiomatic: " Some said: "The King of Qi, the High Emperor's eldest grandson, may be established.

sentences.zh: 」大臣皆曰：「呂氏以外家惡而幾危宗廟，亂功臣。

translations.literal: " The great ministers all said: "The house of Lü, because of evil from the maternal kin, nearly endangered the ancestral temples and threw the merit-holders into disorder.
translations.idiomatic: " The great ministers all said: "The house of Lü, because of evil from the maternal kin, nearly endangered the ancestral temples and threw the merit-holders into disorder.

sentences.zh: 今齊王舅駟鈞，虎而冠。

translations.literal: Now the King of Qi's maternal uncle Siju is a tiger wearing a cap.
translations.idiomatic: Now the King of Qi's maternal uncle Siju is violent as a tiger wearing a cap.

sentences.zh: 即立齊王，復為呂氏矣。

translations.literal: To establish the King of Qi would be to make the Lü again.
translations.idiomatic: To establish the King of Qi would be to make the Lü again.

sentences.zh: 代王方今高帝見子最長，仁孝寬厚，太后家薄氏謹良。

translations.literal: The King of Dai is now the longest-lived among the High Emperor's living sons, humane, filial, generous, and lenient; the empress dowager's clan, the house of Bo, is careful and good.
translations.idiomatic: The King of Dai is now the eldest among the High Emperor's living sons, humane, filial, generous, and lenient; the empress dowager's clan, the house of Bo, is careful and good.

sentences.zh: 且立長固順，況以仁孝聞天下乎！

translations.literal: Moreover to establish the eldest is inherently accordant—how much more when he is known throughout all under Heaven for humanity and filial piety!
translations.idiomatic: Moreover to establish the eldest is inherently accordant—how much more when he is known throughout the realm for humanity and filial piety!

sentences.zh: 」乃相與共陰使人召代王。

translations.literal: " Thereupon together they secretly sent envoys to summon the King of Dai.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon together they secretly sent envoys to summon the King of Dai.

sentences.zh: 代王問左右，郎中令張武等曰：「漢大臣皆故高帝時大將，習兵，多謀詐。

translations.literal: The King of Dai asked his attendants; Gentlemen-of-the-Palace Zhang Wu and others said: "The great officers of Han are all former great generals from the High Emperor's time, skilled in war, full of plots and deceit.
translations.idiomatic: The King of Dai asked his attendants; Gentlemen-of-the-Palace Zhang Wu and others said: "The great officers of Han are all former great generals from the High Emperor's time, skilled in war, full of plots and deceit.

sentences.zh: 此其屬意非止此也，特畏高帝、呂太后威耳。

translations.literal: Their intent does not stop here; they only fear the authority of the High Emperor and Empress Dowager Lü.
translations.idiomatic: Their intent does not stop here; they only fear the authority of the High Emperor and Empress Dowager Lü.

sentences.zh: 今已誅諸呂，新啑血京師，此以迎大王為名，實不可信。

translations.literal: Now the Lü have been executed and they have freshly licked blood in the capital—this, though in the name of welcoming Your Majesty, is truly not to be trusted.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Lü have been executed and they have freshly shed blood in the capital—this, though in the name of welcoming Your Majesty, is truly not to be trusted.

sentences.zh: 願大王稱疾毋往，以觀其變。

translations.literal: I wish that Your Majesty plead illness and not go, to observe how things change.
translations.idiomatic: I wish that Your Majesty plead illness and not go, to observe how things change.

sentences.zh: 」中尉宋昌進曰：「群臣之議皆非也。

translations.literal: " Commandant of the Imperial Guards Song Chang advanced and said: "The counsel of the ministers is all wrong.
translations.idiomatic: " Commandant of the Imperial Guards Song Chang advanced and said: "The counsel of the ministers is all wrong.

sentences.zh: 夫秦失其政，諸侯、豪桀並起，人人自以為得之者以萬數，然卒踐天子之位者，劉氏也，天下絕望，一矣。

translations.literal: When Qin lost its government, feudal lords and powerful heroes rose together; everyone who took himself for the one to obtain it numbered in the tens of thousands—yet in the end the one who trod the Son of Heaven's place was the house of Liu; all under Heaven had given up hope—one thing.
translations.idiomatic: When Qin lost its government, feudal lords and powerful heroes rose together; everyone who took himself for the one to obtain it numbered in the tens of thousands—yet in the end the one who trod the Son of Heaven's place was the house of Liu; the realm had given up hope—one thing.

sentences.zh: 高帝封王子弟，地犬牙相制，此所謂磐石之宗也，天下服其強，二矣。

translations.literal: The High Emperor enfeoffed sons and younger brothers with territory interlocking like dogs' teeth—this is what is called the clan as bedrock; all under Heaven submitted to its strength—two things.
translations.idiomatic: The High Emperor enfeoffed sons and younger brothers with territory interlocking like dogs' teeth—this is what is called the clan as bedrock; the realm submitted to its strength—two things.

sentences.zh: 漢興，除秦苛政，約法令，施德惠，人人自安，難動搖，三矣。

translations.literal: Han rose, abolished Qin's harsh government, simplified laws and ordinances, and bestowed virtue and kindness; everyone found security for himself—hard to shake—three things.
translations.idiomatic: Han rose, abolished Qin's harsh government, simplified laws and ordinances, and bestowed virtue and kindness; everyone found security for himself—hard to shake—three things.

sentences.zh: 夫以呂太后之嚴，立諸呂為三王，擅權專制；

translations.literal: Even under the sternness of Empress Dowager Lü, she established the various Lü as three kings with sole power and authoritarian rule;
translations.idiomatic: Even under the sternness of Empress Dowager Lü, she established the various Lü as three kings with sole power and authoritarian rule;

sentences.zh: 然而太尉以一節入北軍一呼，士皆左袒為劉氏，叛諸呂，卒以滅之。

translations.literal: yet the Grand Commandant, with a single credential entering the Northern Army and one shout, every soldier bared the left shoulder for the house of Liu, revolted against the various Lü, and in the end destroyed them.
translations.idiomatic: yet the Grand Commandant, with a single credential entering the Northern Army and one shout, every soldier bared the left shoulder for the house of Liu, revolted against the various Lü, and in the end destroyed them.

sentences.zh: 此乃天授，非人力也。

translations.literal: This was Heaven's grant—not human strength.
translations.idiomatic: This was Heaven's grant—not human strength.

sentences.zh: 今大臣雖欲為變，百姓弗為使，其黨寧能專一邪？

translations.literal: Now though the great ministers wished to make trouble, the common people would not serve them; could their faction achieve singleness of purpose?
translations.idiomatic: Now though the great ministers wished to make trouble, the common people would not serve them; could their faction achieve singleness of purpose?
